GroupPublic is distinct from Public in terms of having dedicated moderation, and it should not be presented as a joining option that can be confused with Public. Therefore, the priority display for joining from the World tab should be Public (including the creation of new instances).

If a user wishes to join a specific GroupPublic, they can navigate through the Group Activity in the social section, so they should perform that action.

details:
Users sometimes go to the Group Public instance unexpectedly, and that causes trouble or "social drama". This can be mitigated if the app does not select a Group Public instance automatically.

When you open the world detail page in-game, the app selects an instance as the default. I am unsure of the specification of how the app chooses the one, but it could be a Group Public instance.

Although it is explicitly shown as Group Public, and users will see the popup message "You have joined a Group Public instance" when joining, people actually go to Group Public unexpectedly or accidentally.
title: Do not automatically select a Group Public instance
